feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 August 2026 4:42pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 20 August 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea moving eastwards, as high pressure in the Atlantic develops a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Northerly 4 or 5, decreasing 2 to 4 in the east of the area later this evening, becoming 2 to 4 in all waters tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight overnight.


##Weather##

Showers, becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northerly 2 to 4, becoming North or Northwest mainly 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
